title: How it Works - The GenStone Made Easy System
description: Watch these videos to see how the GenStone made easy system makes any home, pillar, column and steel building project simple to accomplish.
text:
How it Works
The GenStone System for Homes, Pillars, Columns and Steel Buildings

Versatile and Easy to Install
Simply measure, cut and attach

The GenStone stacked stone and brick installation systems are designed to make any project from remodels to renovations, pillars, columns and even upgrading the curb appeal of a steel building simple for everyone. Watch the videos below for a quick overview on how each component of our made easy system works together to help you complete your project quickly and easily.

Stacked Stone System
See how the GenStone stacked stone system of panels, corners and ledgers make creating a 4' wainscot as simple as measure, cut and attach.

How To Video

Brick System
Our panelized brick installation system slides together quickly and easily creating the look of a masonry wall without the mortar and without the mess.

How To Video

Pillar Panel System
Our pillar panel system is designed for an 7.75 inch or less square post. The panels can be cut down for smaller posts or stacked vertically for taller posts.

How To Video

Column System
Our 90º outside corner panels assemble together around a 17" post to create a dramatic stacked stone column, perfect for a mailbox, patios and driveway entries.

How To Video

GenStone for Steel Buildings
Discover how GenStone stacked stone and brick panels can be applied to any steel building creating a modern look and adding an insulation value of 3.41 per inch.

How To Video

Next Steps

Now that you’re convinced you can improve your property with GenStone, it’s time to plan your project. You will need the length and height of each wall you plan to install GenStone on in order to determine how many panels, corners, trim and ledgers you will need. We’ve included some helpful resources below to assist you in this process, after you record your measurements, head to our project calculator to input your dimensions and we will tell you how much GenStone you will need for your project.
